presentation.summary: Coordinate evacuation, accountability and controlled re-entry during a facility alarm.
presentation.situation: A facility alarm activates during a busy shift. Contractors and visitors are present and one normal exit route is temporarily unavailable.
presentation.objective: Make five professional safety decisions as conditions change.
knownFacts: A facility alarm activates during a busy shift. Contractors and visitors are present and one normal exit route is temporarily unavailable.

work_authorization_record.title: Evacuation Readiness Record
work_authorization_record.summary: A facility alarm is active while one normal exit is unavailable and contractors and visitors are on site.
details: The usual evacuation pattern is changed because a familiar exit route is closed for maintenance.
Accountability must include employees, contractors and visitors rather than the regular workforce alone.
Available safe exits, muster arrangements and current personnel information are central to the initial response.

control_verification_record.title: Exit Diversion Control Record
control_verification_record.summary: Evacuating occupants are approaching the closed exit and need to be redirected.
details: People are moving toward a route that cannot be used safely in its current maintenance condition.
Clear direction from wardens or equivalent communication is needed before congestion or counterflow develops.
The closed route should remain controlled while occupants are directed toward available safe exits.

condition_change_record.title: Muster Accountability Record
condition_change_record.summary: One contractor cannot be accounted for immediately at the muster point.
details: The contractor's status is unresolved until attendance information and last-known location are checked.
A missing-person status must be communicated to incident command rather than resolved by assumption.
Unprotected personnel should not re-enter the facility simply to search for the individual.

response_record.title: Accountability Verification Record
response_record.summary: A coworker believes the missing contractor may have left site earlier, but the sign-out record is incomplete.
details: The coworker's recollection is useful information but does not independently confirm that the contractor left the site.
The incomplete sign-out record leaves a gap in the accountability evidence.
The person should remain classified according to verified information until location or departure is confirmed.

closeout_record.title: Re-entry Authorization Record
closeout_record.summary: The alarm source is controlled and operations is requesting re-entry.
details: Control of the alarm source does not by itself confirm that every affected area and route is safe for occupancy.
Formal all-clear authority should establish when re-entry is permitted and what restrictions remain.
Re-entry instructions should be communicated and managed so people return in an orderly, controlled way.

prejob_decision_defensible.observable: The situation is partly controlled, but a remaining gap requires recovery.
prejob_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: A partial control is not equivalent to completing every prerequisite.

prejob_decision_best.observable: The work remains controlled and the next stage is approached with the required safeguards verified.
prejob_decision_best.guidedInsight: Verify the complete control sequence before work continues.

prejob_decision_weak.observable: The control gap increases exposure and weakens the work position.
prejob_decision_weak.guidedInsight: Schedule pressure should not replace verification.

prejob_decision_critical.observable: The decision creates a serious loss of control.
prejob_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Do not substitute assumptions for verified control.

safe_completion.title: Safe completion
safe_completion.narrative: The work is completed with controls verified.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: The key controls were verified before work continued.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: Earlier gaps are recognized and corrected before completion.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: The team recovered by restoring the control boundary.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control gaps lead to a significant modeled outcome.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Work continued before the required controls were verified.
